independent_review_design.method: Every original cell via Python scalar finite/flag/weight checks, math.hypot, math.fsum and statistics.median; all saved profiles and all group summaries compared.

limitation: This source-only review is not an observation result or executed numerical review. No full ON/OFF cadence, narrowband sensitivity or calibrated flux claim follows.
source_review: Exact two original Git blob identities bound before and after production.
Header links/dimensions/antenna membership/phase-center/finite sampling checked before Data arrays are read.
External and virtual Data storage rejected.
All cells classified with explicit flag, finite-complex and finite-positive-sample mask; overlapping invalid reasons disclosed.
Ordered baseline and polarization kept separate; unweighted temporal median amplitude.
Coherence weighted by nsamples times integration_time; requires at least two valid distinct times and positive amplitude denominator.
No detection thresholds or drift search; candidate assessment NOT_PERFORMED and original SETI credit zero.
Closed profile archive and summary bound to input/source/manifest identities.

cases: Independent six-cell mask fixture with flagged, nonfinite and zero-weight exclusions
Exact valid counts [2,0,1] and effective exposures [50,0,20]
Independent median amplitudes and two-time coherence hypot(30,240)/250
All production profiles/group summaries agree with independent scalar fixture
Single-time coherence remains NaN for every channel
